## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security fix
- [ ] Database change
- [ ] Documentation or maintenance

## Validation performed

- [ ] Backend tests pass
- [ ] Frontend build passes
- [ ] Formatting and lint checks pass
- [ ] New or updated tests cover the change
- [ ] Manual verification completed where applicable

## Security impact

Describe authentication, authorization, validation, data exposure, upload, logging, or dependency implications. Write `None` when not applicable.

## Database impact

Describe migrations, indexes, constraints, data backfills, transaction behavior, and rollback safety. Write `None` when not applicable.

## API and compatibility impact

Describe changed endpoints, request or response fields, breaking changes, and client impact. Write `None` when not applicable.

## Deployment and rollback

Provide deployment prerequisites and exact rollback instructions.

## Evidence

Attach screenshots, logs, test output, or sample requests when useful.

## Author checklist

- [ ] This branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data were committed
- [ ] No direct production configuration was added
- [ ] Error handling and logging were considered
- [ ] Documentation was updated where required
- [ ] Codex findings were resolved or explicitly documented
